messages:
mira: quick heads-up — brought up int8 reranker (model v3-quant) on the eval harness and seeing a noticeable NDCG@10 drop vs fp16 (~-3.2%). posting config + quick notes below.

mira: eval harness run cmd:
```yaml
model: reranker-v3-quant
precision: int8
seed: 42
candidates_per_query: 10
dataset: prod-sampled-2026-03
preproc: doc_head+sent_filter
batch_size: 128
kvpack: enabled
```

sam: can you confirm the exact holdout split and whether candidate curation changed? also paste the raw ndcg/mrr numbers. :thinking:

mira: holdout: holdout-2026-01 (5% by user), same curation pipeline as previous fp16 run except we changed truncation to `doc_head+sent_filter` to keep leading context. raw: fp16 NDCG@10=0.412, int8 NDCG@10=0.399; MRR fp16=0.298, int8=0.288. seeds identical.

jen: hmm that truncation tweak could bias towards shorter docs if sentences get filtered. did you normalize whitespace / strip HTML? we saw HTML residue distort tokenization before.

mira: initially no HTML strip. reran with `strip_html: true` + `normalize_whitespace: true` — delta improved to NDCG@10=0.405 (int8). still ~-1.7% vs fp16.

liam: try disabling `kvpack` for the quant run — kvpack changes memory layout and can expose quantization sensitivity for attention states. also try `pad_to_max_length: false` for tokenizer.

mira: ran both ablations (one at a time):
- kvpack disabled => int8 NDCG@10=0.403
- pad_to_max_length=false => int8 NDCG@10=0.404
Combining both + strip_html => int8 NDCG@10=0.407. seems like preprocessing + packing interact with quant noise.

eval-bot: rerun complete (run_id=R-20260321-171234). summary: fp16 NDCG@10=0.412, int8 baseline NDCG@10=0.399, int8 with preprocess+no-kvpack=0.407. MRR deltas follow similar trend.

sam: good work. two follow-ups: 1) please run 3 seeds for the best int8 config and report mean + stdev. 2) try `hybrid-quant` (outlier-aware) if available — might recover the last ~0.5-1%.

mira: noted. also want to check sample bias: our prod-sampled-2026-03 has heavier short-query tail than the earlier benchmark set. i'm going to rerun on the canonical eval corpus (benchmark-v2) to make sure this isn't dataset-specific.

jen: yes do that. if the regression disappears on benchmark-v2, we probably have sampling bias in the prod sample — small queries amplify quant noise.

mira: plan posted in the spreadsheet: columns for truncation, strip_html, pad_to_max_length, kvpack, quant_mode, seeds(3). will run overnight and share results.

sam: sgtm, please tag me and liam in the spreadsheet when done. thanks! :thumbsup:

ci-bot: created reproducibility ticket #CC-4982 and kicked off nightly matrix run (configs: preprocess x kvpack x quant_mode).

mira: adding a note for the run: include per-query ndcg distrib (percentiles) + top-k failure cases so we can triage which queries move most.

liam: also dump softmax logits for a small sample — helps see if quant causes sharpening/flattening.

mira: will attach logs + a small repro bundle in the ticket. updating thread once seeded runs finish.
